changelog:
- Initial release: Scrapes weekly tilbudsaviser from 5 Danish supermarkets using the Tjek API.
- Automatically filters and identifies "wow" grocery deals based on price and discount thresholds.
- Publishes a concise wow deals summary and a full organized deal list to your phone via ntfy.sh.
- Supports per-category interest filtering, de-duplication, and weekly scheduling.
- Includes easy setup instructions, configuration template, and troubleshooting notes.
summary: Scrape Danish supermarket weekly tilbudsaviser (Lidl, Rema 1000, Netto, Meny, 365 discount) from the Tjek API and push filtered wow deals to ntfy.sh
